subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Blockbuster Era Begins
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Blockbuster Era Begins.

hook.text: In 1975, Jaws made $470 million and invented the summer blockbuster.

buildup.text: Studios learned that wide releases with massive marketing could create cultural events.

discovery.text: Star Wars in 1977 cemented the formula — spectacle, merchandising, and sequels.

twist.text: Blockbusters brought huge profits but pushed smaller, riskier films to the margins.

climax.text: The model still dominates Hollywood fifty years later.

punchline.text: A shark and a space wizard shaped modern cinema.

quiz.question: What film is credited with starting the blockbuster era?
